reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse any report group description entry (an entry carrying a TYPE, LINE NUMBER, NEXT GROUP, COLUMN NUMBER, SOURCE, SUM, VALUE-in-report-sense or GROUP INDICATE clause of the three §1985:XIII.3.9.2 formats) written in the FILE, WORKING-STORAGE or LINKAGE SECTION, while an ordinary data description entry there stays legal.

edition-consulted.site: ReservedWords (the COBOL-85 reserved-word table, diagnostic COBOL0901)
edition-consulted.switches: LINE is reserved at 85, so a level entry named LINE in WORKING-STORAGE is refused as a reserved word; secondary refusal only

reader.edition-search: The placement itself is structural: report group entries are reachable only through reportSection > reportDescriptionEntry > reportGroupEntry, and a report-only clause in a data description entry falls to the unrecognizedDataClause error production refused by ClosedFormatPass.Refuse at every edition; grepped ClosedFormatPass and the grammar rules for DialectLevel / EditionContext and found no switch on this path.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c27 covers a whole TYPE DETAIL group in WORKING-STORAGE; single report clauses (LINE, COLUMN, SOURCE, SUM, GROUP INDICATE, NEXT GROUP) in a data entry and the FILE and LINKAGE SECTIONs are not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL5506 unexpected 'DE' (TYPE DE group in WORKING-STORAGE), then COBOL0901/COBOL1941
COBOL1941 'LINE' is not a clause of the data description entry for 'WY1'
COBOL1941 'COLUMN' is not a clause of the data description entry
COBOL1941 'SOURCE' is not a clause of the data description entry
COBOL1941 'SUM' is not a clause of the data description entry
COBOL1941 'GROUP' is not a clause of the data description entry
COBOL1941 cannot parse construct near 'NEXT' (NEXT GROUP in WORKING-STORAGE)
COBOL5506 unexpected 'PAGE' (TYPE PAGE HEADING as an FD record)
COBOL5506 unexpected 'RH' (TYPE RH LINE 1 in LINKAGE)
DONE (plain group with VALUE in WORKING-STORAGE)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR1  (3.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: Every report-only clause outside the Report Section is refused at 85 in all three other data sections; the refusal is a parse or closed-format diagnostic rather than one naming this rule, and COBOL5506's hint 'expected a user-defined word or TO' names the 2002 TYPE TO form, which does not exist at 85 (a wording blemish, the program is still refused).

refuter.evidence: Attack: the reader probed FILE, WORKING-STORAGE and LINKAGE only; 1985 also has the COMMUNICATION SECTION (§1985:XIV.2.1), whose CD record description entries are a data section the rule also excludes. Probes: r1 (CD record 01 CREC TYPE DE LINE 1) -> COBOL5506 unexpected 'DE', exit 65; r2 (CD record items with LINE 2 / COLUMN 5 / SOURCE WA) -> COBOL1941 for each clause; r8 (87-char CD record with LINE 1 COLUMN 1 SOURCE) -> COBOL1941 LINE + COBOL0901; r9 (TYPE DETAIL, GROUP INDICATE in a CD record) -> COBOL5506 + COBOL1941. All refused. Control r3 (CD record of 12 chars) is refused only by the CD SR5 87-character rule, not by a report-clause refusal. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR1 'can appear only in the Report Section'; OK §1985:XIV.2.1 'The Communication Section is located in the Data Division'.
